message.content:
The market that draws the biggest crowds in New York City is **Chelsea Market**.  
Located in the Meatpacking District, Chelsea Market is an indoor food hall and retail space that attracts roughly 10 million visitors a year—making it the most‑visited market in the city. It offers a wide range of gourmet foods, artisanal products, and unique shops, and its central location and iconic architecture make it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
